description: Get the analyst questions asked in a call's Q&A, one entry per analyst turn at the microphone, follow-ups included: the analyst and firm, the full question text, who answered, the turn range to read the exchange with GetEarningsCallTranscript or GetInvestorEventTranscript, and audio offsets for calls transcribed from audio. Names appear only for trusted identity resolutions. Pass a ticker with an optional fiscal period, or an eventId.

eventId.description: Investor event id from ListInvestorEvents or GetEarningsCallEvent; reads any event's Q&A, conferences included. When given, ticker and fiscal period are ignored.

fiscalQuarter.description: Company fiscal quarter, 1-4. Quarter alone selects the latest matching quarter across fiscal years; provide both fields for an exact period.

fiscalYear.description: Company fiscal year. Omit both period fields for the latest call; year alone selects the latest call in that fiscal year.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XPAR:AIR) for a listing outside the US. Required unless eventId is given.

name: GetEarningsCallQuestions
title: Earnings Call Analyst Questions
